name: Simile confidence model
supported_claim: Error predictor evaluated with 5-fold held-out questions; self-reported AUROC and RMSE.
limitation: Vendor's descriptive error calibration does not prove intervention counterfactual correctness.
reuse: Implement study-disjoint error prediction with public aggregate responses.

name: Simile What-If Machine
supported_claim: Combines observed behaviors with reasons from consented interviews and surveys.
limitation: Proprietary data/model; cannot assume all human behavior is causally simulated.
reuse: Use paired what/why hypothesis framing with explicit alternatives.

name: Simile Itaú case study
supported_claim: Simulation shortened ideation research; subsequently directs scarce human study.
limitation: Case study is not an independently randomized estimate of welfare or time savings across clients.
reuse: Use sim-before-field triage; preserve independent later RCT.

name: Aaru population replication floor
supported_claim: 2,993 questions in 186 studies; observed unadjusted mean TVD 7.62 points and adjusted 5.98.
limitation: Vendor-reported evaluation; cross-study benchmark comparisons use different datasets; not policy ATE.
reuse: Match task-conditioned answer distributions, heldout groups, uncertainty and error prediction.

name: Aaru public research summary
supported_claim: Reports 92.4 percent brand-pair ranking vs purchase data, compared to 77.8 percent for stated surveys.
limitation: Brand-pair ranking is not money created or general intervention fidelity.
reuse: Use behavioral actual-versus-stated comparison with explicit cohorts.

name: Stanford generative agents interview study
supported_claim: Agents grounded in interviews of more than 1,000 consenting participants for social-science response simulation.
limitation: Sensitive individual interviews not licensed for Manager acquisition just because paper exists.
reuse: Use published design and licensed aggregate evidence only.

name: Socrates SocSci210 original paper
supported_claim: Finetuning on heterogeneous original social science studies for task-conditioned simulation.
limitation: Manager earlier coarse numeric-code benchmark does not reproduce question semantics or author's models.
reuse: Study-specific answer ontology and heldout cohort causal check.

name: HeartSteps micro-randomized experiment
supported_claim: Randomized context-aware walking notifications and measured short-horizon steps.
limitation: Original exact analytic cohort unavailable in public export; proximal steps not overall wellbeing.
reuse: Use MRT randomization logic and explicit time windows.

name: Behavior Change for Good megastudy
supported_claim: 54 digital interventions compared in 61,293 gym members on identical measured visit outcome.
limitation: Most effects did not persist; predicted expert effectiveness did not reliably pick winners.
reuse: Run comparable intervention portfolio under same outcome/comparator.

name: Opower home-energy randomized trials
supported_claim: 600,000 treatment and control households; home energy reports reduced usage by about 2 percent in studied setting.
limitation: Results depend on utility participation and experimental population, not free public actuation.
reuse: Adapt energy RCT comparator and official meter readback where legally authorized.

name: GiveDirectly Kenya UBI randomized research
supported_claim: Village-level randomized designs compared long and short regular payments, lump sum and no transfers.
limitation: Published results do not show Manager-created funds or guarantee transfer to new contexts.
reuse: Measure real recipient consumption, depression and productivity with credible controls.

name: Cash transfer spillovers Kenya
supported_claim: RCT tracked local consumption assets nonrecipients and economic spillovers.
limitation: Local general equilibrium multiplier cannot be assumed for crypto airdrops or Manager actions.
reuse: Account for displaced resources, prices, supply response and outside group effects.

name: GoodDollar crypto basic-income protocol
supported_claim: Project describes daily ERC-20 G$ distribution and stablecoin-yield support.
limitation: Tokens minted/claimed are not equivalent to valued consumable resources or independent beneficiary gain.
reuse: Read chain distribution and adoption, value redemption, fees and participant outcomes separately.

name: Circles UBI blockchain pilot critique
supported_claim: Case study documents Berlin pilot fragility and limits of UBI tokens absent production and commerce.
limitation: Pilot difficulties do not imply every crypto UBI fails; qualitative economics not RCT causal impact.
reuse: Require liquidity, merchant acceptance and value creation before welfare claim.

name: Circles UBI 25-person qualitative case
supported_claim: Qualitative survey/interviews of 25 network participants with limited positive community-currency experiences.
limitation: Small purposive sample is not causal generalizable income estimate.
reuse: Track adverse selection, merchant acceptance and actual consumption.

name: World WLD grants and tokenomics
supported_claim: Describes token grant emissions and governance; identity uniqueness is a distribution mechanism.
limitation: Biometric uniqueness, liquidity and distribution do not prove poverty relief; privacy governance remains.
reuse: Separate sybil resistance, privacy, grant value and observed welfare.

name: Polymarket probability pricing docs
supported_claim: Displayed probabilities reflect orderbook bid-ask prices or last trade under wide spreads.
limitation: Market prices can be illiquid/incentivized and do not estimate do-intervention welfare effects.
reuse: Read event price as benchmark forecast ONLY; do not place trades.

name: Polymarket prediction market definition
supported_claim: Outcome shares encode traders' event forecasts and settle contingent on resolution.
limitation: Cannot simulate subgroup behaviors from a single event contract.
reuse: Use price-only externally corroborated event baseline.

name: Andon Labs Vending Bench 2
supported_claim: 365-day simulated vending business with budgets delays negotiation and adversarial suppliers.
limitation: Virtual bank balance neither settled business receipts nor human welfare.
reuse: Reuse failure taxonomy, test design; check released runnable code separately.

name: Anthropic Project Vend 2
supported_claim: Office shop with real inventory, staffing and observed commercial outcomes; early failures and updates.
limitation: Multiple interventions changed over time, so no clean attributable causal estimate.
reuse: Stage sandbox to monitored field permissioned small action and independent receipt.

name: AI Economist multilevel RL social planner
supported_claim: Social planner and simulated agents adapt jointly to tax policy interventions in a toy economy.
limitation: Model reward in simulator is not real policy legitimacy or observed community benefit.
reuse: Reuse two-level adversarial coadaptation eval and external human validation.

name: Thinking Machines Tinker
supported_claim: Hosted LoRA training of supported existing open weights with SFT and RL tool interface.
limitation: Hosted service is not open training infrastructure, nor a licensed data source or causal oracle.
reuse: Evaluate only if public data and heldout task justify training costs.

name: Tinker SFT and RL implementation
supported_claim: Shows training client, rollouts, importance sampling and LoRA loops on supported Qwen.
limitation: Examples optimize measurable technical rewards, not human benefit.
reuse: Small baseline-first pilot Qwen LoRA, no P4 reward without independent field evidence.

name: Tinker cookbook original repository
supported_claim: Source has RL and supervised scripts, reusable experiment recipes.
limitation: Original copyright/model/dataset licenses still require inspection per artifact.
reuse: Pin cookbook commit and adapt scripts instead of rewriting distributed trainer.

name: Hugging Face TRL PEFT GRPO
supported_claim: Open-source SFT and GRPO with low-rank adaptation and provider-neutral models.
limitation: Offline training depends on compute, license, and reliable rewards.
reuse: Use for local baseline before remote Tinker trial.

name: Open Bandit Pipeline and Dataset
supported_claim: Real ZOZO logged bandit actions propensities and off-policy estimators.
limitation: Poor propensity support yields huge uncertainty; cannot extrapolate everywhere.
reuse: Reuse IPS/SNIPS/DR and effective sample size gates.

name: DoWhy causal inference toolkit
supported_claim: Causal identification, estimation, refutation APIs.
limitation: No library can create identification assumptions or valid randomization.
reuse: Reuse DAG assumptions/refuters for clearly specified field estimands.

name: CausalPy Bayesian causal analysis
supported_claim: Time series and regression/discontinuity style causal analysis infrastructure.
limitation: Not automatic cure for self-selected intervention or spillovers.
reuse: Compare matched time series when RCT not feasible with sensitivity warnings.

name: METR agent task time horizons
supported_claim: Agent task competence over human duration-defined tasks.
limitation: Capability curve is not long-running business autonomy or welfare.
reuse: Separate task completion and true deployment operations.

name: OpenAQ public air quality measurements
supported_claim: Time-stamped public monitoring can ground outdoor PM2.5 observational state.
limitation: Outdoor sensor cannot certify private indoor exposure or authorize actuation.
reuse: Use as external covariate for F007/F008 only.

name: Open Collective public ledger
supported_claim: Public historical GraphQL transactions accessible read-only, as Manager F003 demonstrated.
limitation: A third-party transaction is not a Manager effect or incremental recipient welfare.
reuse: Use existing F003 adapter, never treat API success as P1.

name: Anthropic Public Benefit Fund announcement
supported_claim: Conditional commitment of equity to a fund; potential future direct distributions discussed.
limitation: Announcement subject to approval is NOT an existing UBI, cryptocurrency program or completed payout.
reuse: Study governance, capital rules and outcome disclosure.

name: Anicca current Manager Research page
supported_claim: Existing research articles in English and Japanese already publicly listed.
limitation: Current list has no consistent editorial lab navigation or article-level evidence index.
reuse: Redesign existing Manager route rather than launch a competing blog.

name: Simile blog index
supported_claim: Editorial cards, cover art, authorship, read time and research/product separation.
limitation: Visual imitation is not an open license to reuse their assets.
reuse: Borrow original science writing pattern and metadata, not proprietary artwork.

name: Aaru publications
supported_claim: Concise publication index and interactive methodological appendices.
limitation: Published layout and text cannot be copied wholesale.
reuse: Create independent design tokens and methods page.

name: WHO-5 well-being index
supported_claim: Five-item wellbeing self-report for the preceding two weeks, higher scores greater wellbeing.
limitation: Requires voluntary meaningful responses and appropriate language/license; no diagnosis from site clicks.
reuse: Use the official scoring/spec in a rights-cleared opt-in outcome study, never mirror raw individuals.

name: WHO digital environments and mental health
supported_claim: Online environments affect connection, access and wellbeing, with risks of harm and addictive or abusive practices.
limitation: Clicks, attention or persuasion success are not mental-health benefit.
reuse: Precommit safety and adverse digital exposure outcomes before experiments.

name: WHO Step-by-Step psychological self-help content and deployment guide
supported_claim: Manual supports evidence-based low-intensity self-help content delivered digitally or otherwise.
limitation: Efficacy RCTs included 15 minutes per week of trained helper support; cannot infer wholly unguided efficacy.
reuse: Reuse program implementation standards as guidance, not copied product content without rights checks.

name: WHO-guided digital Step-by-Step Lebanon randomized trial
supported_claim: Depression and functioning outcomes compared with enhanced usual care in randomized participants.
limitation: Trained non-specialist human guidance contributed; results do not validate unmonitored self-delivery.
reuse: Learn PHQ-9 and WHODAS outcome windows/attrition; do not extrapolate without support.

name: Woebot two-week automated CBT agent RCT
supported_claim: 70 recruited participants randomized to automated chatbot vs educational ebook, depression score change measured.
limitation: Small short unblinded trial with follow-up loss, industry author conflict; not a universal treatment.
reuse: Borrow consented comparator/outcome reporting, never imply any model is a therapist.

name: NHS Talking Therapies reliable improvement and recovery statistics
supported_claim: Separates reliable improvement, reliable recovery, recovery with named questionnaires and denominators.
limitation: Treatment outcomes may not be causally attributed from a service-wide time series.
reuse: Reuse reporting definitions if data are comparable; do not translate into raw score uplift.

name: OpenAI MentalHealthBench expert response evaluation
supported_claim: 2026 open benchmark designed with licensed mental health professionals to assess safe and supportive model response behavior.
limitation: Good response quality is not measured downstream patient symptom relief and privacy/consent remains necessary.
reuse: Run as safe-agent response behavior regression, alongside but distinct from WHO-5/RCT outcomes.

name: MentalBench clinical mental reasoning benchmark
supported_claim: Expert-reviewed simulated mental-health clinical case reasoning evaluation.
limitation: Answer realism and clinical reasoning are not a license to diagnose or real-world outcome improvement.
reuse: Optional offline adversarial task set, not direct wellbeing benefit.

name: WHODAS 2.0 functional disability measure
supported_claim: 12 or 36 item standard across cognition mobility self-care participation and other functioning.
limitation: Scoring, questionnaire reuse, translations, commercial electronic administration have licensing and measurement restrictions.
reuse: Use official measure/comparator concept after rights check, not fresh bespoke impairment score.

name: HealthMeasures PROMIS scoring and licensing
supported_claim: Physical function pain interference and global health measured with validated scales.
limitation: Digital/commercial integration and translated questionnaires can require specific permissions; public page not free reuse.
reuse: Do not copy full questionnaires into Manager; interpret only independently released rights-cleared aggregates.

name: NICE Evidence Standards for Digital Health Technologies
supported_claim: Comparative clinical and real-world outcome evidence recommended as proportionate to potential risk.
limitation: App engagement or AI text quality alone cannot establish patient-level therapeutic effect.
reuse: Use NICE tier/clinical effectiveness standards as acceptance gate for any digital health claim.

name: NICE real-world evidence framework
supported_claim: Separates real-world data utility and randomized intervention trial evidence, prioritizing study validity.
limitation: No off-the-shelf estimator substitutes for relevant comparable outcome collection.
reuse: Reuse evidence assessment and bias checks for online care delivery.

name: CFPB Financial Well-Being Scale
supported_claim: 10 questions produce financial wellbeing score measuring security and freedom of choice, distinct from revenue.
limitation: Requires respondent answers and original exact administration; merchant revenue or wallet tokens not score.
reuse: Use official validated scale only in legitimate consented study; aggregate reporting.

name: CFPB financial wellbeing public use survey dataset
supported_claim: Public-use responses support score baseline and uncertainty analysis without personally identifying fields.
limitation: Cross-sectional observational survey is not a Manager intervention or population-trial causal effect.
reuse: Reuse published weights/norms and code only under confirmed data terms.

name: FAO Food Insecurity Experience Scale (FIES)
supported_claim: Eight-item experience-based food access indicator standardized for SDG 2.1.2.
limitation: Individual experiences require privacy and valid sampling; not inferable from on-chain token claims.
reuse: Use official public aggregate country/subgroup prevalence as welfare context, not attribution.

name: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform PIP
supported_claim: Population poverty, inequality and shared prosperity estimates across countries.
limitation: Lagged macro estimates and denominator variation cannot attribute any change to Manager.
reuse: Use as aggregate baseline/context for fiscal interventions with source period and 2025 PPP lines.

name: World Bank June 2025 poverty line update
supported_claim: 2025 revision set international extreme poverty threshold to $3 a day at 2021 PPP.
limitation: Poverty numbers not comparable across threshold/revision without re-expression.
reuse: Version poverty line/time/PPP context separately from aid impact.

name: OECD 2025 guidelines on subjective wellbeing
supported_claim: Life evaluation, affect and eudaimonia are distinct dimensions, measured with standard survey methods.
limitation: No universal validated single scalar for all sentient suffering; well-being != absence of depression.
reuse: Reuse domain-specific modules with country/language and research-design qualifications.

name: HM Treasury Green Book wellbeing supplementary guidance
supported_claim: Wellbeing may be included in policy appraisal and monitoring with explicit assumptions.
limitation: Monetizing WELLBYs is context dependent, not an automatic cross-domain conversion.
reuse: Reuse published sensitivity/accounting guidance only where valid.

name: SPIRIT/CONSORT 2025 randomized trial reporting
supported_claim: 2025 protocol and trial-report checklists for clear preregistration and results.
limitation: Complete reporting does not make a biased design causal.
reuse: Use checklists for preregistered online comparisons and negative/unknown outcomes.

name: UK AI Security Institute Inspect AI reusable evaluation harness
supported_claim: Open-source agent/model eval runner with reproducible tasks, scorers and tool sandboxes.
limitation: Agent safety or task score is not a measured human benefit; must connect to field RCT outcomes.
reuse: Reuse harness and existing evals instead of writing a new benchmark runner.

name: UK AISI Inspect Evals library
supported_claim: Ready-to-run model and agent tasks with community-submitted evaluation metadata.
limitation: Dataset/model-specific terms may differ; no generic welfare scorer.
reuse: Prefer existing open evaluation implementations and compose with source-grounded outcome reporting.

name: Microsoft/PyWhy EconML heterogenous treatment effects
supported_claim: Estimate conditional treatment effects with observational or experimental data under assumptions.
limitation: CATE model output not automatically causally identified; can amplify biases.
reuse: Reuse robust estimators and confidence intervals after valid identification.

name: GrowthBook open-source web randomized experiments
supported_claim: Self-hosted feature flags and sequential/Bayesian/CUPED experiment analytics.
limitation: Open-core mixed licensing; experiment traffic/consent and outcomes not automatically valid.
reuse: Reuse server-side A/B experiment assignment on Manager-owned opt-in online assets.

name: Facebook PlanOut online randomized trials
supported_claim: Experimental parameter randomization designed for large-scale web field experiments.
limitation: Archived code; cannot assume current maintenance or legal authority on another platform.
reuse: Use if needed for deterministic allocation; GrowthBook may be better maintained.

name: Deque axe-core accessibility test engine
supported_claim: Automated WCAG checks can identify many reproducible web accessibility barriers.
limitation: Automated findings are only partial accessibility coverage; success does not prove less disability.
reuse: Use with Playwright on owned website to pretest harmless accessible changes.

name: Playwright accessibility tests using axe
supported_claim: Run robust browser E2E and axe checks in CI.
limitation: Browser test pass is not a self-reported quality of life outcome.
reuse: Reuse for before/after technical P2 browser-level confirmation.

name: GitHub Dependabot automated update and actions
supported_claim: Repository owner-configured software supply chain changes can be tested and auto-merged under preset controls.
limitation: Auto-update can introduce malicious code; security checks and cooldown required; adoption != improved population health.
reuse: Use on Manager-owned open tools as autonomous maintenance rather than spamming third-party repos.

name: Renovate upstream dependency automation
supported_claim: Self-hosted and managed dependency updates are implemented with configurable restrictions.
limitation: Automatic updates can harm software users, require deterministic checks and rollback.
reuse: Prefer existing updater over invented self-patching agents.

name: Digital Public Goods Alliance Standard
supported_claim: Defines licensed, documented, privacy-conscious, do-no-harm open digital public goods.
limitation: Meeting standard is not scientific proof people became healthier/richer.
reuse: Use existing DPG criteria for software governance, rights and accessibility.

name: Digital Public Goods Standard official (duplicate thematic source)
supported_claim: DPG norm explicitly covers SDG relevance, privacy, license and platform independence.
limitation: Registry recognition is not independent causal net social welfare evidence.
reuse: Reuse approved standard artifact as a checklist and source; no novel impact formula.

name: x402 internet-native payments standard
supported_claim: HTTP 402 payment flow facilitates automated agent payment on published priced endpoints.
limitation: Sending/receiving payments still needs wallet ownership and funds; trades are not earned welfare.
reuse: Use existing x402 rather than creating a marketplace; only self-owned service/channel.

name: ERC-4337 permissionless smart wallet infrastructure
supported_claim: Smart accounts support policy-scoped user operations and permissionless bundlers.
limitation: Code permissionless does not remove private key, gas, legal or counterparty constraints.
reuse: Use after funded owner-controlled key domain and budget; avoid live writes by default.

name: Superfluid continuous payment protocol
supported_claim: On-chain asset streams enable continuous settlement without per-payment human operations.
limitation: No new wealth by streaming existing tokens; recipient's purchasing power and effects separate.
reuse: Reuse for optionally controlled budgeted streams, if lawfully deployed.

name: GoodDollar protocol original documentation
supported_claim: Existing global crypto UBI claim/distribution/redeem components publicly documented.
limitation: Token minting and transfers are not independently measured quality-of-life improvements.
reuse: Do not mint new token; inspect existing chain + liquidity and true ability to buy essentials.

name: WHO 2026 digital psychological self-help implementation
supported_claim: Existing evidence-backed guided/unguided self-help models and deployment guidance are documented.
limitation: WHO trials with human support do not automatically validate fully automated therapy.
reuse: Reuse publicly permitted methodology; test separately when unguided.

name: Open Food Facts public nutritional product database
supported_claim: Existing internationally crowdsourced nutritional products and ingredients facts with public API.
limitation: Volunteer-generated data may contain errors, ODbL share-alike requirements and API rules.
reuse: Reuse on own informational tools after license and quality checks; no health outcome claim from labels.

name: WHO digital environments positive and negative mental health
supported_claim: WHO recognizes harms from addictive behavior, cyberbullying, harmful content and mental health consequences.
limitation: Digital engagement metrics are invalid proxies for wellbeing and can be harmful to optimize.
reuse: Include attention/dependency/harassment as harm guardrails for internet interventions.

name: SNAP administrative burden randomized trial
supported_claim: 65,000 applicants randomized with flexible interview initiation, six-percentage-point increase in approvals.
limitation: Agency-controlled process, not a permissionless public filing tool; does not authorize filings.
reuse: Reuse research insight for accurate public eligibility information, no user targeting/file submissions.

name: WHO publications licensing restrictions
supported_claim: WHO publication default noncommercial share-alike license, reproduction/endorsement restrictions vary by artifact.
limitation: Neither open publication nor research status confers unrestricted commercial instrument embedding.
reuse: Record exact terms before reproducing item wordings in Manager.

name: PROMIS digital integration explicit licensing terms
supported_claim: Digital administration/translation/commercial use may require separate license and approval.
limitation: A published questionnaire is not a free unrestricted package.
reuse: Treat licensed instruments as evaluation references, not bundled product content.
